description.value:
Shindroids appear to be almost hume, but these artificial wonders are of a completely foreign and utterly alien nature, created not born.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Shindroids gain +2 Dexterity and Intelligence, but suffer a –2 penalty to Charisma.
  • Size: Shindroids are Medium creatures.
  • Type: Constructed (Ex): Shindroids possess traits of both humanoids and constructs, but are not immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, paralysis, bleed, blind, disease, death effects, necromancy effects, and stunning.
  • Base Speed: Shindroids have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Shindroids begin play speaking Common. Shindroids with high Intelligence can choose any languages they want.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Composite Plating: Shindroids have a +1 natural armor bonus.
  • Robotic Immunities: Shindroids are immune to Fatigued, Exhausted, and Sleep, and immune to fear and emotion-based effects.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Part Robot: Shindroids receive the Cybertech Savant feat at 1st level.
  • Perceptive: Shindroids gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Natural Weapons: Shindroids have a slam attack that deals 1d4 (1d3 if small) points of damage.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Darkvision: Shindroids have darkvision to a range of 60 feet.

Other Racial Traits

  • Immortal: Shindroids do not gain benefits/penalties for aging.
  • Self-Sustained: Shindroids do not eat, drink or breathe, and are immune to starvation, suffocation, and thirst.

Weakness Racial Traits

  • Emotionless: Shindroids take a –4 penalty on Sense Motive checks and can never gain morale bonuses.
  • High Maintenance: Shindroids healed by healing spells work at 50% efficiency.
  • Magic Ineptitude: Shindroids cannot obtain MP nor use spell-trigger items.
  • Rejuvenation Cycle: A shindroid must shut down for 8 hours to recharge or suffer cumulative penalties.
